title: East Nash Luxe | Minutes to Five Points & Nissan
description:
Minutes to Five Points in East Nashville and Nissan Stadium from this spacious 5-bedroom home in East Nashville, perfect for group trips, Titans games, concerts, and weekends in Music City. Enjoy one king, four queen bedrooms, free off-street and on-street parking, a fully equipped kitchen, and quick access to Five Points, Nissan stadium, Broadway and downtown.

The space
Whether you’re visiting for a Titans game, CMA Fest, a concert, a wedding, or a weekend exploring Nashville, this home was designed for groups to spread out and relax. Four private queen bedrooms, Smart TVs in every bedroom, comfortable gathering spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, and free off-street parking make it easy for your group to come home and relax.  After a day exploring downtown or East Nashville, come home to a quiet neighborhood that’s just minutes from all the action.

Guest access
Guests have private access to the entire single family home (no shared walls!), including all five bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, living and dining areas, laundry, backyard, and free on-site parking. Self check-in makes arrival simple, whether you’re getting in after a concert, game, or late flight.

Other things to note
✓ Walkable to Nissan Stadium
✓ Minutes to Five Points, downtown and Broadwsy
✓ Free on-site parking
✓ Self check-in
✓ Four private queen bedrooms
✓ Perfect for families, friends, concerts & game weekends
✓ Commercial photography and filming permitted with approval

Please note that this home is located in an urban neighborhood near downtown Nashville. You’ll enjoy quick access to the city’s best restaurants, nightlife, and attractions while staying in a residential area.
